description.en: Production-ready Tailwind and Radix UI components with copy-paste CLI.
description.zh: 基于 Radix UI 与 Tailwind CSS 构建的高质感组件库，支持 CLI 源码级导入。

content.en: AlignUI is a production-grade design system and component collection built on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS with full TypeScript support. Adopting a copy-paste architecture via the @alignui/cli, it eliminates dependency lock-in by providing accessible, customizable primitives and interactive patterns directly into your codebase. It bridges Figma design tokens with modern front-end engineering, featuring color palettes with OKLCH support, dark mode tokens, and complex controls like color pickers and segmented tabs.
content.zh: AlignUI 是一套基于 Radix UI 底层原语与 Tailwind CSS 构建的现代设计系统与高完成度 React 组件合集。它摒弃了传统黑盒 NPM 包封装模式，依托专用的 @alignui/cli 实现源码级解耦分发与按需注入，赋予开发者完全的代码掌控与定制自由。系统不仅深度打通 Figma 设计令牌（Tokens）与代码实现，原生支持 OKLCH 宽色域、自适应暗色模式与完备的无障碍键盘交互，还提供了涵盖取色器、步进器与数据表格等丰富的高阶交互组件。
